name: xjb-coding
description: Agent Skills for coding workflows, multi-user multi-agent collaboration via the xjb_code backend, Bruno API and workflow tests, real-browser Web debugging (ego-browser first on macOS), Web prototypes, requirement planning prototypes, editable draw.io and Archify interactive diagrams, Blender + Three.js, and local ComfyUI workflows. One skill set shared by Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes.

interface.shortDescription: 编码、Bruno 测试、draw.io 图表
interface.longDescription: xjb_coding packages the workflow Skills a coding agent needs end to end: refine requirements, split tasks, code with TDD behind four quality gates, checkpoint and resume across sessions, and coordinate several agents through the optional xjb_code backend (per-user API keys, shared task board, human approvals). It also covers Bruno API and workflow tests with official references and real import validation, real-browser Web debugging that prefers the official ego-browser (ego lite) skill on macOS, sketch-to-prototype Web UX, single-file requirement planning prototypes (two-end screen comparison, call chain with parameters, per-end hardening), editable draw.io diagrams with bundled official guidance, Archify interactive standalone HTML diagrams, Blender + Three.js assets, and editable local ComfyUI workflows with official references and local extensions. Bruno, draw.io Desktop for exports, Comfy CLI/MCP and ego lite are external tools; missing tools produce setup instructions. Source and docs: https://github.com/0xdevelop/xjb_coding
